original.statement: Cilium 1.16 adds a new metric, cilium_identity_label_sources, counting identities per label source (e.g. separate fqdn and cidr label metrics); no operational consequence.

decision.reason: [ev-793c99a321e0] lists `cilium_identity_label_sources` under the 1.16 upgrade notes' "Added Metrics" and attaches no configuration, flag or values condition to it. So any environment upgrading from a release before 1.16.0 gains the metric, and edge-from-version in-range <1.16.0 is neither broader nor narrower than what the evidence supports. The consequence is informational only, so this boundary condition creates no mandatory work.
